completed_changes: Phases 1-6 compatibility refactors, BaoTa deployment hardening, blacklist fixes and trace-monitor stabilization remain intact
Phase 7 Category admin uses true server-side paging, full-database name search, server type filtering and lightweight default columns
Phase 7 real admin paging was user-observed with 4713 rows and 1000 rows per page
Phase 8 shows Category pagination at both top and bottom using native BootstrapTable paginationVAlign=both
Phase 8 Category add closes after a successful insert without automatically refreshing the 1000-row parent list
Phase 8 new Category records default the payment selector to paid
Phase 8 removes Category admin list write-on-read cs/cstime reset
Phase 8 centralizes daily category counting in CategoryDailyStat and stores YYYYMMDD instead of day-of-month, preserving daily reset/increment semantics
Phase 8 category hit updates use a transaction and row lock to avoid concurrent lost updates
Phase 8 card generation keeps the visible prefix-plus-12-hex format but replaces MD5/time/rand with random_bytes and checks collisions against existing codes
Phase 8 card type validation and insert-result validation are explicit, while one-row-at-a-time transactional insert semantics remain
Phase 8 blank card add/use/end time values normalize to zero to match the NOT NULL schema
Phase 8 prevents manually adding another active blacklist row for the same UDID while preserving expired history
Phase 8 blacklist UI labels expired historical rows as expired instead of deleting them
Phase 8 adds a guarded production access-log audit tool for App-mb.php and Index2.php; the files remain until production logs confirm no use

performance_findings.conclusion: Existing whole-payload external encryption is the dominant /appstore latency; appstore/appstore_v2 encryption behavior remains intentionally unchanged.

intentionally_preserved_boundaries: App-mb.php and Index2.php are not deleted until the BaoTa production access logs are audited
Existing historical duplicate blacklist rows are not destructively deduplicated
Expired blacklist history is retained rather than automatically purged
No database unique index is added to fa_kami because existing production duplicates have not been migrated/audited
TLS verification and the external appstore/appstore_v2 encryption protocol remain unchanged
Trace identities remain labels supplied by client payload position
next_task: Install the Phase 8 BaoTa package on a test/compatible site. Verify top+bottom paging, add-without-refresh, paid default, daily cs/cstime rollover, card generation/activation, blacklist duplicate/expiry display, then run tools/legacy_controller_access_audit.sh against /www/wwwlogs before deleting App-mb.php or Index2.php.
